title: Sitcom Laugh Track
blurb: The sitcom laugh track — canned studio laughter, declaring that a joke has occurred whether or not one has. That's the entire meme value: play it after anything and the anything retroactively becomes a punchline. Awkward silences, bad news delivered cheerfully, your own life decisions — all improved by an invisible audience finding them hilarious. The technique dates to 1950s radio and was always slightly sinister; using it ironically just makes the subtext text. Comedy's second-oldest special effect, after the fart.
origin: Classic canned studio-audience laughter from the sitcom era.
